components.name: ResumePage
components.purpose: Complete web and print resume template driven by a single `ResumeData` JSON object. Provides `"single-column"` and `"sidebar"` layouts, A4 and US Letter sizing, ATS-linear DOM order and automatic black-on-white print output even in dark mode.

props.name: data
props.description: Complete JSON-serialisable resume data object conforming to `ResumeData`.

props.name: layout
props.description: Page layout: "single-column" (linear ATS flow, default) or "sidebar" (two-column print/web layout).

props.name: paperSize
props.description: Target print paper geometry: "a4" (210mm, default) or "letter" (8.5in).

props.name: forcePrintPreview
props.description: Forces black-on-white print tokens on screen (useful for previewing print output in dark mode).

components.example:
import { ResumePage, sampleResumeData } from "@kalaa/react";

<ResumePage data={sampleResumeData} layout="single-column" paperSize="a4" />

components.name: PortfolioPage
components.purpose: Complete personal portfolio page template driven by a single `PortfolioData` JSON object. Composes `ProfileCard`, `CaseStudyCard`, `ProjectList`, `Timeline`, `SkillGroups`, `TestimonialCard`, `LinkList`, `ContactCard` and `PageFooter` with semantic landmarks.

props.name: data
props.description: Complete JSON-serialisable portfolio data object conforming to `PortfolioData`.

components.example:
import { PortfolioPage, samplePortfolioData } from "@kalaa/react";

<PortfolioPage data={samplePortfolioData} />

components.name: LandingPage
components.purpose: Complete product and marketing landing page template driven by a single `LandingPageData` JSON object. Composes `Hero`, `StatsBand`, `FeatureGrid`, `TestimonialCard`, `FAQ`, `CTA` and `PageFooter` with accessible landmarks.

props.name: data
props.description: Complete JSON-serialisable marketing page data object conforming to `LandingPageData`.

components.example:
import { LandingPage, sampleLandingPageData } from "@kalaa/react";

<LandingPage data={sampleLandingPageData} />

components.name: ResumeHeader
components.purpose: Top identity block for a web or print resume with candidate name (`h1`), professional title, location and contact links.

props.name: badge
props.description: Optional availability or status label shown in a badge.

components.example:
import { ResumeHeader } from "@kalaa/react";

<ResumeHeader
  name="Aarav Deshmukh"
  title="Principal Systems Architect"
  location="Pune, India"
  email="aarav.deshmukh@example.invalid"
/>

components.name: Summary
components.purpose: Executive summary block with a section heading, concise narrative paragraph and optional bulleted highlights.

props.name: highlights
props.description: Optional factual highlights shown as a bulleted list.

components.name: ExperienceList
components.purpose: Chronological work history block composed of `ExperienceItem` entries with role, organisation, semantic `<time>` dates, outcome bullets and technology `Badge` tags.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: Section heading level (default 2; items render one level deeper).

components.name: ExperienceItem
components.purpose: Chronological work history block composed of `ExperienceItem` entries with role, organisation, semantic `<time>` dates, outcome bullets and technology `Badge` tags.

props.name: startDate
props.description: ISO or human-readable start date (rendered inside `<time>`).

props.name: endDate
props.description: ISO or human-readable end date, or "Present" if current.

props.name: tags
props.description: Technology or domain tags shown as badges.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: Heading level for the role title (default 2 when standalone, 3 inside ExperienceList).

components.name: EducationList
components.purpose: Academic qualifications block showing degrees, institutions, graduation `<time>` dates, thesis notes and honours badges.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: Section heading level (default 2; degree titles render one level deeper).

components.name: SkillGroups
components.purpose: Categorised skill groups rendered inside a semantic `<dl>` with Kalaa `Badge` items. Supports responsive `"grid"` or narrow `"stacked"` sidebar layouts.

props.name: layout
props.description: Visual arrangement: "grid" (default) or "stacked" for narrow sidebars.

components.name: ProjectList
components.purpose: Grid or stack of `ProjectCard` blocks built on Kalaa `Card`, `KeyValue` and `Badge` with impact numbers, technology tags and links.

props.name: columns
props.description: Number of columns on wide screens (default 2).

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: Section heading level (default 2; project titles render one level deeper).

components.name: ProjectCard
components.purpose: Grid or stack of `ProjectCard` blocks built on Kalaa `Card`, `KeyValue` and `Badge` with impact numbers, technology tags and links.

props.name: description
props.description: Concise explanation of what was built and why.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: Heading level for the project title (default 2 when standalone, 3 inside ProjectList).

components.name: Certifications
components.purpose: Professional certifications block with issuer name, `<time>` dates, optional verification link and credential ID `Badge`.

components.name: Languages
components.purpose: Spoken and written languages block pairing each language name with a proficiency `Badge`.

props.name: items
props.description: Spoken or written languages with proficiency labels.

components.name: Awards
components.purpose: Honours, awards and peer-reviewed publications list (`Awards` and `Publications`) with `<time>` dates, issuer details and category `Badge`.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: Section heading level (default 2; entry titles render one level deeper).

components.name: Publications
components.purpose: Honours, awards and peer-reviewed publications list (`Awards` and `Publications`) with `<time>` dates, issuer details and category `Badge`.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: Section heading level (default 2; entry titles render one level deeper).

components.name: ProfileCard
components.purpose: Personal identity and bio card with monogram avatar, availability `Badge`, tabular-figure stats, skill tags and `ButtonLink` actions (at most one primary).

props.name: availability
props.description: Availability status (for example "Available for architecture reviews").

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: Heading level for the person's name (default 2).

components.example:
import { ProfileCard } from "@kalaa/react";

<ProfileCard
  name="Aarav Deshmukh"
  role="Principal Systems Architect"
  bio="I design high-throughput telemetry engines and calm operator consoles."
  availability="Available for Q1 reviews"
/>

components.name: CaseStudyCard
components.purpose: Portfolio case study card built on Kalaa `Card`, `KeyValue`, `Badge` and `ButtonLink` with structured Challenge/Outcome rows and `<time>` year.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: Heading level for the case study title (default 2 when standalone, 3 inside a section).

components.example:
import { CaseStudyCard } from "@kalaa/react";

<CaseStudyCard
  title="Substation telemetry pipeline overhaul"
  client="Vayu Grid Systems"
  year="2025"
  summary="Replaced a polling collector with a bounded-memory Rust stream compactor."
  metrics={[{ label: "Recovery time", value: "22 s" }]}
/>

components.name: Timeline
components.purpose: Chronological milestone list rendered as a semantic `<ol>` with `<time>` dates, role/project titles, subtitles and `Badge` tags.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: Section heading level (default 2; milestone titles render one level deeper).

components.name: TestimonialCard
components.purpose: Endorsement card built on Kalaa `Card` (`as="article"`) with a semantic `<blockquote>`, `<cite>` author attribution, role, organisation and `<time>` date.

props.name: author
props.description: Full name of the person quoted.

props.name: date
props.description: Date or year of the endorsement.

components.example:
import { TestimonialCard } from "@kalaa/react";

<TestimonialCard
  quote="Aarav turned our most fragile telemetry service into the calmest part of our stack."
  author="Meera Kulkarni"
  role="VP of Engineering"
  org="Vayu Grid Systems"
/>

components.name: ContactCard
components.purpose: Direct contact card built on Kalaa `Card`, `KeyValue`, `Badge` and `ButtonLink` with email, location, response time and a primary `mailto:` action.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: Heading level for the card title (default 2).

components.example:
import { ContactCard } from "@kalaa/react";

<ContactCard
  title="Start a technical conversation"
  email="aarav.deshmukh@example.invalid"
  location="Pune, India"
  responseTime="Within 1 business day"
/>

components.name: LinkList
components.purpose: Annotated link collection for writing, talks, repositories or profile hubs. Supports `"stacked"` rows with descriptions or compact `"inline"` rows.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual variant: "stacked" (default, with descriptions) or "inline" (compact horizontal bar).

components.name: Hero
components.purpose: Top marketing hero block with optional release `Badge`, IBM Plex Serif `h1` headline, value proposition, `ButtonLink` actions (one primary, one secondary) and factual highlights.

props.name: eyebrow
props.description: Optional badge label above the title.

props.name: highlights
props.description: Short factual highlights below the actions.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: Heading level for the hero title (default 1).

components.example:
import { Hero } from "@kalaa/react";

<Hero
  eyebrow="Release 2.4"
  title="Calm telemetry for high-voltage operations"
  description="Ingest, compact and inspect millions of sensor events per second."
  primaryAction={{ label: "Deploy sample cluster", href: "#cta" }}
/>

components.name: FeatureGrid
components.purpose: Responsive 2- or 3-column grid of product capabilities built from `SectionHeader`, Kalaa `Card` and `Badge`.

props.name: features
props.description: Feature items rendered as Kalaa `Card` blocks.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: Section heading level (default 2; feature cards render one level deeper when heading is set).

components.name: StatsBand
components.purpose: Horizontal benchmark and KPI band rendering figures with `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` inside a semantic `<dl>`.

props.name: stats
props.description: Key metrics rendered with tabular numerals.

components.name: CTA
components.purpose: Call-to-action card with a 3px accent start border, serif heading, description, optional note and `ButtonLink` actions.

components.name: FAQ
components.purpose: Frequently asked questions block built on native HTML `<details>` and `<summary>` elements so disclosures work without client-side JavaScript.

props.name: items
props.description: Question and answer pairs rendered as native `<details>` disclosures.

props.name: defaultOpenAll
props.description: Opens all items by default (also ensures full answer visibility when printing).

components.name: PageFooter
components.purpose: Semantic `<footer>` landmark with the Kalaa `LogoMark`, brand tagline, uniquely labelled `<nav>` link columns and utility links.

props.name: showLogo
props.description: Whether to render the Kalaa mark next to the brand name.

components.example:
import { PageFooter } from "@kalaa/react";

<PageFooter
  brandName="Pravah Telemetry"
  tagline="Built with Kalaa design tokens and components."
  copyright="© 2026 Pravah Telemetry Systems."
/>

components.name: SectionHeader
components.purpose: Consistent section heading (`h2` or `h3`) with an optional `Badge`, muted description and secondary `ButtonLink` action.

props.name: badge
props.description: Optional status or category badge text.

props.name: action
props.description: Optional secondary action link on the right.

components.example:
import { SectionHeader } from "@kalaa/react";

<SectionHeader
  title="Engineered for predictable operations"
  description="Every layer is inspectable, schema-validated and operable from the keyboard."
/>

components.name: AppShell
components.purpose: Page frame with a sticky 240px sidebar (full-page background) and a main area (max 1120px). Use it once per app, with `brand`, `AppShell.NavItem` children in `nav`, and `footer` for account or theme utilities. Pass `render={<NextLink href="..." />}` on `NavItem` for client-side routing.

props.name: header
props.description: Optional content above the main area (for example a page header).

props.name: brand
props.description: Brand slot at the top of the sidebar (logo, app name). Stays beside the Menu button on small screens.

props.name: footer
props.description: Footer or utility slot at the bottom of the sidebar (theme toggle, account, sign out).

components.name: PageHeader
components.purpose: Title row for a page: optional back link, one `h1`, muted description and right-aligned actions. Pass `back={{ href, label, render: <NextLink href="..." /> }}` for client-side routing in Next.js.

props.name: back
props.type: { href: string; label: string; render?: useRender.RenderProp; }
props.description: Link above the title to the parent page.

props.name: actions
props.description: Buttons on the right of the title row; at most one primary.

props.name: variant
props.description: "brand" sets the title in serif for marketing pages.

components.name: Card
components.purpose: Bordered surface that groups related content. A header row appears only when there is a title or actions.

props.name: actions
props.description: Content on the right of the header row.

props.name: titleLevel
props.description: Heading level of the title (default 2). Use 3 or 4 when the card sits under a section heading.

components.example:
import { Card } from "@kalaa/react";

<Card title="Products" description="Manage your catalog.">24 products</Card>

components.name: KeyValue
components.purpose: Definition list for facts about one thing. `rows` has a label column and dividers; `grid` fits summaries.

props.name: items
props.description: Label and value pairs; an empty value shows an em dash.

props.name: layout
props.description: "rows" (label column with dividers, default) or "grid" (compact summary).

components.example:
import { KeyValue } from "@kalaa/react";

<KeyValue items={[{ label: "Status", value: "Draft" }, { label: "Stock", value: "88 units" }]} />

components.name: ValueComparison
components.purpose: Compare an original value with a proposed value. Panels stack when their container is narrow. Set a contextual accessible name when showing multiple comparisons and use a separate control for accepting a proposal.
components.example:
import { ValueComparison } from "@kalaa/react";

<ValueComparison />

components.name: EmptyState
components.purpose: Centred message for a list or area with nothing in it, with one optional next step.

props.name: title
props.description: What is missing, for example "No products yet".

props.name: action
props.description: One next step, usually a Button.

components.example:
import { EmptyState } from "@kalaa/react";

<EmptyState title="No products yet" description="Add a product to start your catalog." />

components.name: Button
components.purpose: Action button. `primary` is the main next step, `secondary` the default, `ghost` low-emphasis inline actions, `danger` destructive ones.

props.name: variant
props.description: primary (main next step), secondary (default), ghost (low emphasis) or danger (destructive).

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a spinner, disables the button and sets `aria-busy`; keeps its width.

components.example:
import { Button } from "@kalaa/react";

<Button variant="primary">Save changes</Button>

components.name: ButtonLink
components.purpose: A link that looks like a Button, for navigation. Same variants and sizes; works with any router through `href` or the Base UI `render` prop (for example `next/link`).

props.name: variant
props.description: primary (main next step), secondary (default), ghost (low emphasis) or danger (destructive).

props.name: render
props.description: Replaces the `<a>` element, for client-side routing. Pass your router's link, for example `render={<NextLink href="/products" />}` with `next/link`. Kalaa props and classes are merged onto it.

components.name: Field
components.purpose: Wraps one control with a label, optional hint, error and required marker, and wires `aria-describedby` and `aria-invalid`.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label above the control, in sentence case.

props.name: error
props.description: Error message; marks the control invalid.

components.example:
import { Field, Input } from "@kalaa/react";

<Field label="Product title" hint="Shown on the storefront.">
  <Input defaultValue="Cold-pressed mustard oil 1 L" />
</Field>

components.name: Input
components.purpose: Single-line text input (native props plus `size` and `invalid`). Put it in a `Field` to get a label and error text.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Shows the danger border and sets `aria-invalid`.

components.example:
import { Input } from "@kalaa/react";

<Input aria-label="Product name" placeholder="Enter product name" />

components.name: Textarea
components.purpose: Multi-line text input with the same look as Input; `autoResize` grows it with its content.

props.name: size
props.description: Text size and padding: sm or md (default).

props.name: invalid
props.description: Shows the danger border and sets `aria-invalid`.

props.name: autoResize
props.description: Grows with its content instead of scrolling.

components.example:
import { Textarea } from "@kalaa/react";

<Textarea aria-label="Product description" autoResize />

components.name: Select
components.purpose: Dropdown built on Base UI Select, with keyboard support (arrows, type-ahead, Escape).

props.name: options
props.description: Choices as value and label pairs.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Text shown when nothing is selected.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Shows the danger border and sets `aria-invalid`.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the field required in forms.

components.name: Checkbox
components.purpose: Checkbox with a label and optional description, built on Base UI. Supports `indeterminate` for select all.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label, shown to the right of the box.

props.name: description
props.description: Optional help text under the label, linked with `aria-describedby`.

components.example:
import { Checkbox } from "@kalaa/react";

<Checkbox label="Show on storefront" defaultChecked />

components.name: Switch
components.purpose: On/off setting that applies immediately, with a label and optional description.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label, shown to the right of the switch.

props.name: description
props.description: Optional help text under the label, linked with `aria-describedby`.

components.example:
import { Switch } from "@kalaa/react";

<Switch label="Track stock" description="Warn when fewer than 20 units are left." />

components.name: Tabs
components.purpose: Switches between views of one subject. `segmented` for compact filters, `underline` for page sections.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initially selected tab when uncontrolled (default: first enabled).

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the selected tab value.

components.name: Banner
components.purpose: Inline message in one of four tones; `warning` and `danger` are announced as alerts.

props.name: tone
props.description: Meaning and colour. Warning and danger use `role="alert"`, the others `role="status"`.

components.example:
import { Banner } from "@kalaa/react";

<Banner tone="warning" title="1 field needs attention">Fix the price before approving.</Banner>

components.name: Badge
components.purpose: Small label with a tone (neutral, info, success, warning, danger). Status colours are for status only.

props.name: tone
props.description: Colour meaning: neutral (default), info, success, warning or danger.

components.example:
import { Badge } from "@kalaa/react";

<Badge tone="success">Approved</Badge>

components.name: StatusBadge
components.purpose: A Badge whose tone comes from a status word, in one mapping table: approved is success, needs review is warning, rejected is danger.

props.name: status
props.description: Status word such as "approved" or "needs review"; unknown words render neutral.

components.example:
import { StatusBadge } from "@kalaa/react";

<StatusBadge status="needs review" />

components.name: ProgressBar
components.purpose: Progress of a task with a required label (visible or hidden) and a tone.

props.name: hideLabel
props.description: Hides the label visually but keeps it for screen readers.

props.name: tone
props.description: Fill colour: accent (default), success, warning or danger.

components.example:
import { ProgressBar } from "@kalaa/react";

<ProgressBar label="Import progress" value={45} />

components.name: Dialog
components.purpose: Modal dialog on Base UI with focus trap, Escape to close and a labelled close button. Sizes sm, md and lg (400, 560, 720px).

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the dialog opens or closes.

props.name: trigger
props.description: Element that opens the dialog (usually a Button).

props.name: title
props.description: Dialog heading; also its accessible name.

props.name: footer
props.description: Actions row, for example Cancel and Save.

components.name: Table
components.purpose: Table component in @kalaa/react.
components.example:
import { Table } from "@kalaa/react";

<Table />

components.name: DataTable
components.purpose: A sortable table for small record sets. The caller owns the rows, editor fields, validation, and persistence. Supply stable row IDs and give each editor control an accessible label.
components.example:
import { DataTable } from "@kalaa/react";

<DataTable />

components.name: Pagination
components.purpose: Pagination component in @kalaa/react.
components.example:
import { Pagination } from "@kalaa/react";

<Pagination />

components.name: Toolbar
components.purpose: Groups filters and actions while preserving ordinary Tab navigation.
components.example:
import { Toolbar } from "@kalaa/react";

<Toolbar />

components.name: Meter
components.purpose: Meter component in @kalaa/react.

props.name: value
props.description: Score from 0 to 100. A missing or invalid score is shown as unavailable.

components.example:
import { Meter } from "@kalaa/react";

<Meter />

components.name: SuggestionReview
components.purpose: SuggestionReview component in @kalaa/react.
components.example:
import { SuggestionReview } from "@kalaa/react";

<SuggestionReview />

components.name: Logo
components.purpose: The Kalaa square: a frame (the unlit moon) with a lit L-shaped crescent, plus an optional wordmark lockup. Colours follow `--kalaa-text` and `--kalaa-accent`, so it changes with theme and accent.

props.name: variant
props.description: "mark" is the square only; "lockup" adds the Kalaa wordmark.

props.name: size
props.description: Height of the mark in px (the wordmark scales with it). Minimum 16 for the mark, 96px wide for the lockup.

props.name: title
props.description: Accessible name of the mark. The lockup shows its own "Kalaa" text and ignores it.

props.name: mono
props.description: Single-colour version: frame and corner both use currentColor.

components.example:
import { Logo } from "@kalaa/react";

<Logo variant="lockup" size={28} />

components.name: CodeBlock
components.purpose: Monospace code with a Copy button. If the clipboard is unavailable it says to select the text and copy it.

props.name: code
props.description: The code to show and copy.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the code region, for example "Install command".

props.name: language
props.description: Hint for readers and tools, for example "bash" or "tsx". Not highlighted.

components.example:
import { CodeBlock } from "@kalaa/react";

<CodeBlock label="Install command" code="pnpm add ./vendor/kalaa-react-0.1.0.tgz" />

components.name: Avatar
components.purpose: Compact identity badge showing an image or initials derived from `name`. Uses `--kalaa-radius-full` for circular user badges and `--kalaa-radius-md` (`shape="square"`) for workspaces or teams.

props.name: name
props.description: Person or team name; used to derive up to two initials and as the accessible label.

props.name: src
props.description: Optional image URL; falls back to initials if omitted or if loading fails.

props.name: shape
props.description: True circle (`--kalaa-radius-full`, default) or theme-shaped square (`--kalaa-radius-md`).

components.example:
import { Avatar } from "@kalaa/react";

<Avatar name="Asha Rao" />

components.name: Breadcrumbs
components.purpose: Hierarchical trail inside a `<nav aria-label="Breadcrumb">` landmark, marking the final item with `aria-current="page"`. Supports client-side routing via `render` on each item.

props.name: items
props.description: Trail from root to the current page.

components.name: Combobox
components.purpose: Searchable single-value dropdown built on Base UI Combobox. Filters options as you type and supports full keyboard navigation (Arrow keys, Enter, Escape).

props.name: options
props.description: Choices as value and label pairs.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called when the selected value changes.

props.name: emptyMessage
props.description: Message shown when no option matches the search query.

components.name: Divider
components.purpose: 1px rule in `--kalaa-border` with `role="separator"`. Supports horizontal rules (with an optional centred label) and vertical rules for toolbars.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Axis: horizontal (default) or vertical (for toolbar and inline groups).

props.name: label
props.description: Optional inline text centred on a horizontal divider.

props.name: decorative
props.description: Hides the separator from the accessibility tree (`role="none"`).

components.example:
import { Divider } from "@kalaa/react";

<Divider label="Import options" />

components.name: DropZone
components.purpose: Drag-and-drop and click-to-browse file target with `accept` filtering and a built-in `maxSizeBytes` size-limit notice and validation message.

props.name: label
props.default: "Drop a file here, or click to browse"
props.description: Primary prompt inside the drop target.

props.name: accept
props.description: Accepted MIME types or extensions (for example ".csv,text/csv").

props.name: maxSizeBytes
props.description: Maximum file size in bytes; displays a size-limit message and rejects larger files.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Allows selecting more than one file at once.

props.name: onFiles
props.description: Called with accepted files after a drop or file-picker selection.

props.name: onReject
props.description: Called when a file is rejected (size limit exceeded or type mismatch).

components.name: Icon
components.purpose: Curated 24-icon set for operational interfaces: inline 24×24 SVG strokes using `currentColor`. Decorative by default (`aria-hidden="true"`); pass `label` when the icon stands alone without text.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for an icon that stands alone. Omit it for decorative icons next to text (they are hidden from screen readers).

components.example:
import { Icon, Button } from "@kalaa/react";

<Button iconStart={<Icon name="upload" size="sm" />}>Import CSV</Button>

components.name: Link
components.purpose: Inline text link in the accent colour, always underlined so it does not rely on colour alone. Pass `render={<NextLink href="..." />}` for client-side routing in Next.js.

props.name: render
props.description: Replaces the `<a>` element, for client-side routing. Pass your router's link, for example `render={<NextLink href="/products" />}` with `next/link`. Kalaa props and classes are merged onto it.

components.name: Menu
components.purpose: Action menu on Base UI Menu with full keyboard support (Arrow keys, Home/End, type-ahead, Enter/Space, Escape). Pass an `items` array or compose with `Menu.Item` and `Menu.Separator`.

props.name: trigger
props.description: Button or element that opens the menu.

props.name: items
props.description: Declarative list of menu items and separators (alternatively pass `Menu.Item` children).

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the menu opens or closes.

components.name: MultiSelect
components.purpose: Searchable multi-value picker on Base UI Combobox (`multiple`), rendering selected values as removable chips inside the control. Designed to replace 20-checkbox lists inside table and column-mapping rows.

props.name: options
props.description: Choices as value and label pairs.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled array of selected option values.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial selected option values when uncontrolled.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called whenever the selected values array changes.

props.name: emptyMessage
props.description: Message shown when no option matches the search query.

components.name: Popover
components.purpose: Anchored non-modal overlay built on Base UI Popover for filter controls, quick inspectors or rich explanations.

props.name: trigger
props.description: Element that opens the popover on click (usually a Button).

props.name: description
props.description: Optional supporting copy under the heading.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the popover opens or closes.

props.name: side
props.description: Preferred side relative to the trigger (default "bottom").

components.example:

SKU, Title, Status

components.name: AppearanceMenu
components.purpose: Anchored appearance picker built from Kalaa `Popover` and `RadioGroup` for switching theme (`auto`, `light`, `dark`), accent colour (`neel`, `geru`, `mayur`) and corners (`square`, `soft`). Persists under the `"kalaa.theme"` `localStorage` key and syncs across tabs and `<kalaa-theme-picker>`.

props.name: label
props.description: Trigger button and popover heading label (default "Appearance").

props.name: side
props.description: Preferred popover side relative to the trigger (default "bottom").

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial popover open state when uncontrolled.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the popover opens or closes.

props.name: triggerVariant
props.description: Visual variant of the trigger button (default "ghost").

props.name: onAppearanceChange
props.description: Called when the user changes theme, accent or corner shape.

components.example:
import { AppearanceMenu } from "@kalaa/react";

<AppearanceMenu />

components.name: RadioGroup
components.purpose: Mutually exclusive choice list built on Base UI RadioGroup, with arrow-key roving focus and optional per-option descriptions. Always uses `--kalaa-radius-full` so radio buttons remain circular in both square and soft shape themes.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called when the selected radio changes.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables every option in the group.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks a selection required in forms.

components.name: Skeleton
components.purpose: Layout placeholder shown while records or cards load. Decorative (`aria-hidden="true"`); pulses gently and stops under `prefers-reduced-motion`.

props.name: variant
props.description: Shape preset: text line (default), rectangular block, or true circle (avatar placeholder).

props.name: width
props.description: CSS width (number in px or string such as "60%").

props.name: height
props.description: CSS height (number in px or string).

components.example: import { Skeleton } from "@kalaa/react";

components.name: Slider
components.purpose: Single-thumb range control on Base UI Slider with tabular readout and keyboard support (Arrow keys, Home, End, Page Up/Down). Track uses `--kalaa-radius-pill` and the thumb uses `--kalaa-radius-full`.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label associated with the slider thumb.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called as the slider thumb moves.

props.name: showValue
props.description: Shows the formatted numeric value opposite the label (default true when `label` is set).

components.example:
import { Slider } from "@kalaa/react";

<Slider label="Minimum match confidence" defaultValue={80} min={0} max={100} step={5} />

components.name: Spinner
components.purpose: Indeterminate activity ring using `currentColor` and `--kalaa-radius-full`. Announces `role="status"` with a visually hidden label unless marked `decorative` (as inside `Button loading`).

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible text announced to screen readers (`role="status"`). Ignored when `decorative`.

props.name: decorative
props.description: Hides the spinner from assistive tech; use when the surrounding control already says it is busy.

components.example:
import { Spinner } from "@kalaa/react";

<Spinner label="Validating import rows" />

components.name: Stat
components.purpose: Single operational metric with a sentence-case label, tabular figure, optional status delta and comparison help line.

props.name: label
props.description: Metric name in sentence case (for example "Products pending review").

props.name: value
props.description: Primary figure, rendered in tabular numerals.

props.name: delta
props.description: Optional change indicator (for example "+14%" or "-3 rows").

props.name: deltaTone
props.description: Meaning of the delta badge: neutral (default), success, warning or danger.

props.name: help
props.description: Secondary context or comparison period below the value.

components.example:
import { Stat } from "@kalaa/react";

<Stat
  label="Products approved"
  value="1,284"
  delta="+6.4%"
  deltaTone="success"
  help="Compared with the previous 7 days"
/>

components.name: Toast
components.purpose: Transient status notification stack built on Base UI Toast (`ToastProvider` + `useToast()`). Mount `ToastProvider` once near the root of your app and trigger notifications with `const { toast } = useToast()`.

components.name: Tooltip
components.purpose: Brief non-interactive hint on Base UI Tooltip that appears on hover or keyboard focus and dismisses with Escape.

props.name: content
props.description: Brief label or keyboard shortcut shown inside the tooltip.

props.name: children
props.description: Focusable trigger element (for example a Button).

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the tooltip opens or closes.

props.name: side
props.description: Preferred side relative to the trigger (default "top").

props.name: delay
props.description: Hover delay in milliseconds before opening (default 250).

props.name: className
props.description: Additional class name on the popup element.

components.example:
import { Tooltip, Button } from "@kalaa/react";

<Tooltip content="Export filtered rows as UTF-8 CSV">
  <Button>Export CSV</Button>
</Tooltip>
